name: Chess Chatter
source:
A short visual novel about a dangerous post-apocalyptic sport of chess. In a world where stakes are high and food is shit, one man and one woman find themselves in the arena. Watch as their story unfolds. 

[From [url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-31/?action=preview&uid=17960]Ludum Dare[/url]]

Created for [url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/2014/12/03/welcome-to-ludum-dare-31/]Ludum Dare 31[/url] (theme: Entire Game on One Screen).
